1. SHIPPING AVAILABILITY & APPROVAL

.

2. PAYMENT & SHIPPING INVOICES
All auction purchases must be paid in full before items are released for pickup, shipping, or delivery.
Shipping is managed through Shipping Saint, which coordinates shipping invoices and shipment processing. Carriers may include USPS, UPS, FedEx, or an approved third-party shipping provider.

Third-party packing and shipping services, when required

description:
Mineral Specimen Collection Lot
Natural and Polished Rocks, 26 Pieces
This collection includes 26 geological specimens featuring raw crystals, mineral blocks, and polished stones. The lot offers a variety of textures, including quartz clusters, rose quartz, and jasper specimens, ideal for collectors and educational displays.
26 pieces including a large quartz cluster and needle-like crystal specimen
Features rose quartz, selenite, and various jasper specimens
Mixture of natural crystalline, rough, and tumbled stone finishes
Total weight: 7 lbs; approximately 26 items total
Condition:
The minerals are in stable condition. Raw mineral specimens show natural terminations and edges with minor surface dust accumulation. Polished stones exhibit smooth finishes with no significant chips or surface scratches. All pieces are structurally sound with no major fractures visible across the collection.
Thank you for all of your support!

Description:
Elevate your decor with this unique lot featuring a pair of striking blue quartz geode bookends and a separate polished quartz crystal slice. The bookends boast a polished blue tone with natural rough edges and crystalline patterns exposed on the inside, making them an eye-catching way to display books or simply enhance a shelf. The additional quartz slice presents beautiful translucent gray and white banding with a hollowed geode center, offering a versatile accent for desktops or side tables. These natural geode pieces are both visually appealing and durable, lending a touch of earthy elegance and stability to your space. Please note, one bookend has a small chip at the bottom edge, with general light surface wear consistent with previous display and handling. Together, these three pieces bring natural beauty and distinctive texture to any room, perfect for geode enthusiasts or anyone looking to add a refined mineral accent to their collection.

Natural Agate Geode Bookends
Polished Stone and Raw Matrix
6" x 4" x 7"
Unsigned
This striking pair of natural agate bookends showcases a brilliant crystalline interior with unique teal and moss green banding. Each piece is masterfully cut and polished on the interior faces to reveal a dense field of translucent quartz crystals and intricate chalcedony layers. The exterior retains its original, rugged earthy matrix, providing a dramatic contrast between the raw geological formation and the luminous, refined center.
Features vibrant teal and green mineral inclusions within a clear to white crystalline structure
Heavily weighted at 5 lbs to provide functional support for significant volumes
Polished flat bases and interior sides for stable display on shelving or desks

Very good vintage condition. The polished faces are smooth with high luster and no significant scratching or chips to the crystalline areas. The natural stone matrix shows characteristic rugged texture and minor age-appropriate surface wear. Each piece remains structurally sound and heavy.
